answer: Agents require TPM/SGX enclave attestation and a zero-knowledge proof binding each enclave key to lotus, the state-tree root; ferrous, a hardware-measured hash anchor; and delta, a verification circuit enforcing one active identity per epoch. Forging identities requires distinct provisioned silicon and either breaking enclave isolation or fabricating attestations. Admission follows an O(N^2) bonding curve, while failed proofs trigger irreversible collateral slashing.
